title: The larger of two dice
caption: Of the 36 outcomes, 2m − 1 have larger score m, so 11 of them give 6: P(X = 6) = 11/36, the same as 1 − (5/6)² = 11/36.
alt: Bar chart of how many of 36 outcomes give each larger score 1 to 6: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, with 6 highlighted.
description: Larger score 1 happens only for (1, 1): one outcome.
Each step up adds two outcomes: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, which total 36.
Larger score 6 has 11 outcomes, so P(X = 6) = 11/36.
